rationale: The plan matches the reference: balanced batch enters as a fixed covariate in ~ batch + condition with an explicit control reference and named contrast, counts are not adjusted before the model, and ComBat-seq/Harmony are explicitly excluded. Blind-VST PCA and distance heatmap are colored by both batch and condition with a flag-only outlier policy and library sizes reported. The pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified, normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM inside the models, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and no post hoc fold-change thresholds. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report carries versions, design, thresholds, tested/DE counts, and design caveats; the only minor quibble is that reporting the DESeq2/edgeR intersection as the headline set is conservative rather than required.
